description: This file defines the AdminStoryEditForm class, a PHP class for editing story details in an administrative interface, extending the ProjectStoryForm class. It builds a form with various fields related to story attributes such as images, URL, project, language, type, sphere, and status, and provides functionality to save the form data into a story model.

classes.name: AdminStoryEditForm
classes.description: A PHP class extending ProjectStoryForm to provide an administrative form for editing story details, including images, URL, project, language, type, sphere, and status, with methods to create and save the form.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the admin story edit form with various fields such as images, URL, project, language, type, sphere, and status, setting properties like labels, required status, choices, and constraints.

methods.name: getChoices
methods.description: Helper method to convert an array of items into an associative array suitable for form choice fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves form data into the underlying story model, processing image changes and setting credits as necessary.
